description: This file defines a PHP class 'Ip' in the namespace Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Fraud. The class provides methods related to IP address checks for fraud detection, including checking whether an IP is flagged as fraudulent and retrieving IP data from the database.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Model class for handling IP address related fraud detection logic in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks whether the order's IP address or associated customer IPs are flagged as fraudulent and returns the corresponding order status ID if so.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP records from the database matching a specific IP address.
